title: Simplify booking form to require only Name, Phone Number, and Location

requirements.summary: Remove Brand selection UI and Request Type selection from the booking (register request) form.
acceptanceCriteria: The booking form no longer displays the Brand dropdown and the conditional 'Specify Brand' input.
The booking form no longer displays the 'Request Type' radio group (service/spares).

file_operations.description: Remove the Brand Select UI (including the conditional 'other brand' input) and remove the Request Type radio group from the form. Update related imports, local state, and any label/placeholder text that referenced these removed inputs.

requirements.summary: Update booking form validation so only Name, Phone Number, and Location are required; all other fields remain optional.
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting the form with only Name, Phone Number, and Location filled succeeds (assuming the user is authenticated).
Category, Address, and Description (if still shown) do not block submission when left empty and do not show 'required' validation errors.
Name and Location are validated as non-empty strings.
Phone Number is validated as non-empty and continues to use the existing phone-number format validation.

file_operations.description: Adjust validateForm() to require only customerName, phoneNumber (keeping the existing regex validation), and location. Ensure category/address/description do not produce required errors when empty, and update UI indicators (e.g., '*' markers and error rendering) accordingly.

requirements.summary: Preserve request creation by supplying frontend defaults for removed Brand and Request Type fields when calling the existing createRequest flow.
acceptanceCriteria: The frontend still calls the existing createRequest flow successfully without requiring user input for Brand or Request Type.
A request created via the simplified form can be opened on the success and detail pages without client errors.

file_operations.description: Update submit logic to pass sensible defaults to useCreateRequest(): set brand to an 'other' Brand variant with empty text, set requestType to a single default (e.g., RequestType.service), and send empty strings for optional text fields (category/address/description) when not provided. Keep navigation to the existing success route unchanged.
